comment.body: Thanks for the detailed reconnect repro. Current main now has two Dock changes that match this symptom family: #49705 refreshes the displays list when entering Dock settings, and #49814 fixes Dock breakage on monitor topology changes such as disconnect/reconnect and monitor reappearance. Since this issue was filed against 0.100.2 before those merges, the next maintainer step is to verify the repro on a build that includes both fixes and close it as handled if the behavior is gone.
